Maya (PM): Quick heads-up — competitor 'SwiftEmbed' announced cheap, sub-10ms embeddings for short sequences. We should talk about whether this shifts our roadmap.
Lena (Eng): Saw that. Their tradeoff seems aggressive quant + custom kernels. We can probably match latency but not cost without changing batching/caching.
Ben (SRE): If we push for latency parity we'll need dedicated tuning and more GPUs — impacts Dedicated capacity offering.
Priya (Sales): Customers already pinging us — they want similar price points or they switch. Prioritization pressure incoming.
Omar (Design): Are we talking feature parity (same API surface) or matching unit economics? The positioning changes either way.
Maya (PM): Good question. Proposal: two-track response — 1) quick parity: API compatibility for embeddings + a lite-quantized model we can ship as a fast-follow; 2) medium-term differentiator: Smart batching + prefix caching to beat them on $/req.
Lena (Eng): Quick parity spike: 1 week to validate quantized model + perf harness. But shipping to Hosted will be low-risk; Dedicated/Private changes take longer.
Ben (SRE): Also need to check telemetry — if we enable more aggressive cache sharing we might expose tenant perf cross-talk. We should run an isolation test.
Priya (Sales): For GTM, we can frame parity as 'compatible and reliable' and push differentiator as 'lower total cost at scale' — gives breathing room.
Claire (CEO): Agree on two-track. Timeline-wise, we need a demo for two PoC customers in 3 weeks. Ask: can Eng commit to spike by EOW?
Lena (Eng): I'll own the spike. Ben + I will run perf harness and isolation tests. Omar — we need a minimal API docs update if we expose parity shim.
Omar (Design): I'll draft a single-page compatibility note and a minimal FAQ for Sales.
Maya (PM): OK owners: Lena spike, Ben isolation, Omar docs, Priya customer comms. I'll prepare a decision doc with launch criteria.
Maya (PM): Launch criteria suggestion: 1) avg embedding latency <12ms for 64-token median, 2) unit cost within 20% of competitor at 100k qps sim, 3) no degradation in other customers in isolation tests.
Priya (Sales): Sounds good. I'll line up two accounts for PoC and a pricing ask to negotiate.
deploy-bot: New perf harness build #876 succeeded: https://ci/internal/builds/876 :rocket:
Ben (SRE): Nice. Lena, can you drop the quick spike notes in the doc? I'll start the isolation test config.
Lena (Eng): Dropped an initial run in the perf dashboard, linking results here: https://internal/perf/runs/1749000000
Maya (PM): Great — let's sync tomorrow 10am to review spike outputs and make a go/no-go call for parity rollout.
Priya (Sales): 10am works. I'll bring feedback from customers.
Claire (CEO): Keep executive brief light — only escalate if we hit blockers. Thanks team :pray:
